text:
emma (Product): FYI — AWS Marketplace partner asked for our full security evidence pack for listing. Need to pull together ASAP, target submission by 04/10.

sam (Partnerships): Do they want SOC only, or the pen-test report + questionnaires too? I asked for clarification but no reply yet.

mike (Security): They typically ask for: SOC 2 Type II (PDF), pen-test executive summary, vuln scan report (Nessus/Detectify), DAST/SCA summary, architecture/network diagram, data flow, and our DPA/KMS attestation. Also proof of encryption at rest (KMS/HSM).

tara (Eng): I can regenerate the architecture and data flow diagrams. Which network diagram level do they want — high level or subnet/VPC routing details?

mike (Security): Start with a high-level diagram + an appendix for VPC/Subnet + security groups. For AWS Marketplace they sometimes want the CIDR and endpoint list for marketplace integration.

sam (Partnerships): They just replied: "Please provide SOC2 Type II, pen test summary (redacted), vulnerability scan artifacts, DPA, and a completed security questionnaire. If you can supply a short attestation letter that's great."

emma (Product): Ok — owner assignments: Mike -> SOC2 + attestation + questionnaire answers; Tara -> arch & network diagrams + devops runbook snippet; Sam -> coordinate upload to their portal & legal for DPA; I’ll draft the attestation cover note. Timeline: ready drafts by 04/08 for review.

mike (Security): Action items I’ll cover: (1) Locate latest SOC2 PDF (S3 link), (2) Redact pen test raw logs -> produce executive summary + remediation timeline, (3) Export last 30-day vuln scan CSV, (4) Fill questionnaire template.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline report available at https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/3921 — last infra-scan: 2026-03-20.

sam (Partnerships): Thanks — tagging legal for DPA review: @legal. If anyone has a standard attestation template, drop it here. Also need a short blurb for the marketplace listing about data residency and encryption.

tara (Eng): Dropping a quick sample for the arch diagram file name: "redwood-aws-marketplace-arch-2026-03.v1.svg". I’ll add a short network appendix showing VPC peering and NAT gateways.

mike (Security): Note on pen-test: red team recommended patching CVE-2025-### in service gateway, we have an open PR with mitigation ETA 04/03. I will mark that in the remediation timeline.

emma (Product): Great. Sam — can you confirm upload method (portal vs SFTP) once legal chimes in? We should aim to handoff everything to partner ops by 04/09.

sam (Partnerships): Will do. If portal requires specific file names, I’ll rename during upload. Also prepping a one-page "security highlights" summary for their marketplace reviewers.

mike (Security): Upload checklist I’ll use: 
```
- SOC2_TypeII.pdf
- PenTest_Summary_redacted.pdf
- Vulnerability_Scans_YYYYMMDD.csv
- DAST_Scan_Report.pdf
- Architecture_Diagram.svg
- DataFlow.pdf
- DPA_signed.pdf
- Security_Questionnaire_filled.xlsx
- Attestation_Letter.pdf
```

emma (Product): Perfect. If anything blocks, ping me. I’ll follow up with partner to push the deadline if needed. :thumbsup:

sam (Partnerships): Thanks team. I’ll update this thread when legal confirms the DPA path.
